title_en: Near the Air Albania Stadium, 3+1+2 Apartment for Sale at a Bargain Price!!!
description_en: In the best area of ​​Tirana, very close to the Air Albania Stadium, 3+1+2 Apartment for sale with perfect orientation. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a well-managed building with a total area of ​​125 m2 and is organized by a corridor that divides the large living room together with a kitchenette with access to the balcony, a studio room, a matrimonial room, a children's room with access to the balcony, two toilets and two balconies. Apart from being suitable for living, the apartment is also a good opportunity for sharing, considering the area with a high demand for apartments for daily rent. The area where it is located is one of the best and preferred in Tirana for a high quality of life, as it is 10 meters from the entrance to the large lake park. The property has full mortgage documentation.
